summary:
I built the design. `ShellReveal.Walk` now reads the target's own attributes before the open. For a Hidden target that is not a volume root, it asks Explorer's view once, through a read-only `SHGetSetSettings(0x00040001, false)`. When that view hides the item, Walk returns Failed / `HiddenByExplorerSettings` with `HiddenBy` and a nullable `View`, and never calls the open. The app's status line now reads "Nothing was opened: Explorer hides '<leaf>' (<Folder Options label(s)>)." and the blanket hidden note is gone, so Exact leaves the line empty.

A test override, `OverrideExplorerView`, can only hide: the view used is the real one ANDed with the override. The hook arms it from `FSA_HOOK_EXPLORER_VIEW` before Main and stops the app before Main if arming fails. New window case R-003 checks refusals through the shipped exe and opens no Explorer window. The `NoExplorerViewMember` mutant was added, and the R-001 / B-007 / B-008 / S-001 / S-006 pins were moved to the new text.

In `.taad/fitness.yaml`, attempt 1's leftover block is gone, the two src rules are now twinned with xUnit tests (with plant rows recorded AS-RECORDED by the harness), and one SL-091 settled block holds the tests/window rule. The registry-write spellings are closed as a class in a 63-row corpus with its own test. Results: Core suite 689 passed, plus the same 3 last-access failures that were already there; R-003, S-001, S-006, B-007 and B-008 pass, though B-008 fails one pre-existing check under C:\WINDOWS\TEMP; all 12 window mutants pass; the harness gave 15/15 AS-RECORDED.

files.why: RevealReason.HiddenByExplorerSettings; ExplorerHides flags; ExplorerView (Shows, Hides, FromShellState bits 0/15, And). RevealOutcome gains HiddenBy and a nullable View. Walk reads the attributes before the open and refuses a Hidden item the view hides, with no ancestor reads. ReadExplorerView uses a read-only SHGetSetSettings. OverrideExplorerView (Volatile, hide-only AND) and EffectiveExplorerView are added, and RevealAsync passes the effective view.
FormatRevealStatus: the Exact+Hidden note is deleted. New refusal branch puts the outcome and leaf first, then the Folder Options labels (HidingOptions).

FakeShell injects and counts view reads. New tests cover each design case: not-hidden items × 4 views, plain items under +H/+H+S folders, H-only refused, landings, H+S naming each setting, a deny-all +H+S folder, the real System Volume Information and the H+S *.sys at C:\ (never skipped), the volume root, earlier failures, the decode table, the HKCU cross-check, and the override AND over every pair. The old H+S Exact test is replaced and the real-tree test asserts no view reads.
O-044 class corpus: 63 lines across src and tests/window, each marked fire, quiet or known miss now, alongside what the design's declared patterns did with it.
Feeds each corpus row to rule B's patterns (read from its Fact) and to rule C's (read from fitness.yaml), and to the declared pre-n2 patterns.

O-043 reconciliation: attempt 1's four-rule block and the engine's appended A/C are deleted. Rules A and B are twinned above the first marker. One '# settled by SL-091' block holds rule C, with corrected text (m5) and n2/class patterns.
F41-F48 and P32-P33 for the twinned rules, S39-S43 for the settled rule, recorded AS-RECORDED by harness --only. The note is updated.

ArmExplorerView in Initialize next to ArmFailListing: logs format/type/member/invoke failures and throws before Main (m3). StatusFit logs the untrimmed status-line width and the characters that fit (n4). Docs updated.
The reveal record gains hiddenBy, view (effective) and injected.

Adds R-003 (steps a-d), Read-ExplorerSettings, Expected-HiddenBy, Expected-RefusalText, CheckRefused and CheckInjected. R-001 step 5 now derives hs_file.sys and h_file.dat from the settings in force (n5). B-007/B-008/S-001/S-006 are pinned to the longest refusal ($RevealStatusText), and CheckStatusShown prints the width record. FSA_HOOK_EXPLORER_VIEW is in the hook variables; R-003 is in the case lists.
Required mutant NoExplorerViewMember (ValidateSet, $CaseMutants, the All roster, MayFail-free expectation).

Design note: what changed, the Folder Options labels resolved on this PC, the measured/predicted predicate table, known limits (Windows 10 per Q-197, host ancestor rows, (1,1)), the one Hidden=2 person sitting, C-004 replacement text (Q-198), the rules and how they are checked.

obligations.how: ShellRevealTests.Walk_ItemNotHidden_PlainOrSystemOnly_OpensWithoutReadingTheView: real plain and System-only files and folders × all four injected views. Each is Exact, with 0 view reads, open once, free once and View null. Passed.

ShellRevealTests.Walk_HiddenItemWhoseEverySettingShowsIt_Lands: H-only file, folder and a >260-char file at 1|0 and 1|1 are Exact with one view read and the open reached. The old note is deleted from MainWindow (Select-String 'only highlights it if' finds nothing), so Exact leaves the status line empty. R-001 step 5 checks the empty line through the exe, but R-001 is person-run.

ShellRevealTests.Walk_HiddenOnlyWhileHiddenFilesAreNotShown_RefusesWithoutOpening at 0|0 and 0|1: Failed/HiddenByExplorerSettings, HiddenBy=HiddenFiles, HResult 0, open 0, free 1. R-003(a) checks the same through the exe. Mutation verified: with the gate removed, 7/7 rows fail.

Walk_HiddenSystemWhileASettingHidesIt_RefusesNamingEachSettingThatHides at 1|0: HiddenBy=ProtectedFiles only, open never called. R-003(d) checks the same through the exe under this PC's real settings (Hidden=1, ShowSuperHidden=0) with the text naming only the protected-files setting. No Explorer window opened.
The same theory at 0|0 gives HiddenFiles, ProtectedFiles. R-003(a) and (c) under an injected 0|0 show both labels in the status text.
Walk_HiddenItemWhoseEverySettingShowsIt_Lands includes H+S file and folder at 1|1 (Exact). This is the one unmeasured landing cell, pinned as its own rows and marked predicted in the design note.

ShellRevealTests.Walk_RealProtectedItemsAtTheSystemRoot_AreRefusedAndNeverOpened runs the real parse and resolve-back on an STA thread at 1|0. C:\System Volume Information, hiberfil.sys, pagefile.sys and swapfile.sys were all refused with ProtectedFiles and open was never called, so the attribute read succeeds through the parent's listing. The test never skips.
ShellRevealTests.Walk_VolumeRoot_IsExemptAndReadsNoView: C:\ at 0|0 is Exact with 0 view reads and View null.

ShellRevealTests.Walk_EarlierFailureOnAHiddenSystemTarget_KeepsItsReasonAndReadsNoView on a real H+S file (and 'hs.' through \\?\) at 0|0: NoLongerExists, ParsedAsAnotherItem and NameUnaddressable each keep their reason, read no view, and free the pidl once where one was made.
ShellRevealTests.FromShellState_ReadsBitZeroAsHiddenAndBitFifteenAsProtected over 0x0, 0x1, 0x5, 0x8, 0x7FFE, 0x8000, 0x8001 and 0xFFFF7FFE.
ShellRevealTests.ReadExplorerView_AgreesWithTheRegistryOnThisPc: on this PC HKCU Hidden=1, ShowSuperHidden=0 and the shell reads ShowsHidden=True, ShowsProtected=False. Read-only.

Reveals the H+S temp file and folder through the shipped exe with no injection; both are refused with ProtectedFiles and the exact text, and no Explorer window opened. H-only targets are expected to land and are reported owed to a person. The old pins at 2150/2206/4360 and R-001 3781-3782 are moved.

R-003 step (a) under an injected 0|0 covers H-only and H+S files and folders plus an H+S file with a 200-character name. All are refused with the exact text, and the long one equals the B-007/B-008/S-001/S-006 pin, with no window opened. Minimum-size layout is carried by those pins, as M1 decided, not by R-003.

R-003 has no minimum-size or inView step. The three FSA_HOOK_STATUS pins (B-007, B-008, S-001/S-006) are re-pinned to the longest new text: both labels with a 200-char leaf. R-003(a) asserts the real reveal's text equals that pin. Mutation verified: reverting the pin to the old note turns R-003 red.

ArmExplorerView runs in Initialize beside ArmFailListing (unarmed = ArmFailListing() ?? ArmExplorerView()). R-003(b) covers the malformed value, and the NoExplorerViewMember mutant covers a missing member. Mutation verified: arming and carrying on turns R-003(b) red. Step (b) targets the H+S file, so even that failure opens nothing under 1|0.

Both src rules are twinned: verbatim Facts plus single-quoted (?m) entries with including_comments: true above the first marker. Plants F41-F48 and P32-P33 are AS-RECORDED. rules-parity reports AGREE 18 facts / 22 twinned / 48 patterns, and RuleCases -Case C-001 held. R-003 checks all three label variants: HiddenFiles only for H-only at injected 0|0 in (a), both for H+S at injected 0|0 in (a) and (c), and ProtectedFiles only for H+S under this PC's settings in (d). Exact text each time, no window opened, and Exact-expected targets are not clicked.

fitness.yaml reset to HEAD's 1086 lines, which deletes attempt 1's block and the engine-appended A/C. Rules A and B are written above the first marker with this design's single-line patterns. One '# settled by SL-091' block now holds rule C only. Plants were recorded afterwards. Harness clean baseline: 85 rules, 0 hits. Parity: 63 settled.
obligations.not_mutable: The change removes duplicate settled entries that only the engine's Fitness reads, and no xUnit test reads settled entries. The evidence is the parity counts, the harness clean baseline, and ExplorerSettingsWriteRuleTests reading rule C by name.

obligations.how: Closed as a class. The corpus enumerates write spellings by their producers (C#: Microsoft.Win32 API, shell set flag, Win32/shlwapi writes; PowerShell: ItemProperty cmdlets, reg.exe, .NET API in either quote, Add-Type/hook C#), plus look-alikes and 6 pinned known misses. Rules B and C are widened to match: n2's patterns plus (?i), verbatim strings, ReadWriteSubTree, Remove/Clear, reg delete, $True, ::SetValue, writable OpenSubKey/CreateSubKey, and the RegSetKeyValue/SHSetValue family. The test shows the declared patterns let 24 rows through and the guards now catch all 24. Mutation verified.

R-003 step (c) is its own run: root C:\ through Format-AppArgument, FSA_HOOK_REVEAL='top:pagefile.sys' (the first H+S *.sys found), the scan stopped after the root listing by RevealMode's top: route, and FSA_HOOK_EXPLORER_VIEW=0|0. pagefile.sys was refused with both labels and no window opened, in about 20 s for the whole case, never a completed C:\ scan.
obligations.not_mutable: This is test routing. Taking it out means either a completed C:\ scan, which the engine's 0.5 GB pool guard forbids running unattended, or dropping the step. Evidence is R-003(c) passing on real C:\.

obligations.how: The hook's StatusFit measures the untrimmed text with FormattedText.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace against ActualWidth and binary-searches how many characters fit before the ellipsis. It logs statusTextWidth/statusWidth/statusFits/statusChars, and CheckStatusShown prints them and asserts the refusal lead fits. Mutation verified: reverting to DesiredSize turns S-001 red.

The pin is moved in Test-R001 step 5, not R-002. It derives hs_file.sys's expectation, and a new h_file.dat's, from HKCU in force. If refused, it checks text and that no window opened; if Exact, it checks an empty status and selection. The design note's person item is worded for R-001.
obligations.not_mutable: R-001 opens real Explorer windows and is person-run (Q-176 covered SL-089 only), so no unattended test can be turned red by undoing the move. Its expectation helpers (Expected-HiddenBy, Expected-RefusalText) are the ones R-003 exercises.

mandatory.where: ShellReveal.Walk refuses before the open, with no Explorer COM, the setting named on the status line (MainWindow.FormatRevealStatus/HidingOptions), never written (twinned rule TheAppNeverWritesExplorersSettings), and volume roots exempt. The predicate is own attributes only, fixed after the measurements, as Q-175 required.

No COM automation of Explorer in src. Exact is reported only for items Explorer will show (ExplorerView.Shows); the attributes come from one read. The 'opened the parent' wording is superseded by Q-175's refuse-and-open-nothing.
Behaviour matches the note: refuse, name the setting, open nothing, volume roots exempt. The C-004 replacement text is in docs/design/SL-091-hidden-reveal-refuses.md and proposed in `architecture`.
docs/design/SL-091-hidden-reveal-refuses.md 'Known limits': Windows 10 decode and filter not measured. The repo has no release-notes or known-limits list, so the note is the record.
RevealStatus stays one NoWrap ellipsis line. B-007, B-008, S-001 and S-006 at 560x644 with the longest refusal keep every list's full row and the 15.96 px line (passed).
Ran WindowMutants.ps1 -Mutant All at build: 12/12 passed, including the new NoExplorerViewMember. Validate still owes its own run.
R-003 clicks only reveals expected to be refused, so no Explorer window opens. R-001 and R-002's landing steps stay person-run, because Q-176's exception covered SL-089 only.

architecture.find: which asks the shell to open the item's parent with the item selected (for a hidden item, noting that Explorer highlights it only when set to show hidden files) or, when the item no longer exists, has a name the shell cannot address, parses as another item, or the shell call fails, says so on the status line and opens nothing.
architecture.replace: which asks the shell to open the item's parent with the item selected or, when the item no longer exists, has a name the shell cannot address, parses as another item, is hidden by Explorer's own view settings (Hidden while hidden files are not shown, or Hidden and System while protected operating system files are hidden, as read from the shell's settings and never changed; volume roots exempt), or the shell call fails, says so on the status line, naming the setting that hides it, and opens nothing.
architecture.why: src/FsAnalyser.Core/Native/ShellReveal.cs Walk now returns Failed/HiddenByExplorerSettings before the open when ExplorerView.Shows is false (ReadExplorerView uses SHGetSetSettings with the set flag false). src/FsAnalyser.App/MainWindow.xaml.cs FormatRevealStatus deleted the Exact+Hidden note and words the refusal with the Folder Options label(s). WindowCases.ps1 -Case R-003 passed through the shipped exe with no Explorer window opened. Q-198 makes this the agreed C-004 behaviour.

deviations: Rule B (src) is wider than the design and n2 asked, to close the class (O-044): (?i) on the SetValue pattern because registry value names are not case-sensitive; @? for verbatim strings; (?i) and ReadWriteSubTree on the OpenSubKey pattern, which attempt 1 caught; and the RegSetValue pattern widened to RegSetKeyValue, SHSetValue and SHRegSetUSValue. Every pattern stays single-line, and the corpus rows pin each widening.

Rule C (tests/window) is wider than the design: Remove/Clear-ItemProperty, reg delete, (?i) on the shell call (PowerShell writes $True), SetValue in either quote, writable OpenSubKey and CreateSubKey, and the RegSetValue family, beside n2's -Name and ::SetValue patterns. The design's 'path held in a variable is not caught' no longer holds when -Name names Hidden or ShowSuperHidden; the known misses left are pinned in the corpus.

Attempt 1's settled rule 'the Core tests never change the person's Explorer settings' (tests/**/*.cs) is not carried over: this design did not declare it, and n1 said to delete the attempt-1 block whole. The Core tests only read HKCU.

R-001 step 5 also reveals a new Hidden-only h_file.dat with the derived expectation. Without it, the design's filed person item ('an H-only reveal at (1,0) lands with an empty status line') had no step to run.

R-003 step (b) targets the Hidden+System file, which the design left unspecified. If the hook ever failed to arm, the reveal would still be refused under any settings but (1,1), so nothing opens on this PC.

CheckStatusShown gained one assertion beyond n4's logging: the refusal's lead ("Nothing was opened: Explorer hides '") must show before the ellipsis. It turns m1's ordering into something a run checks.
The Folder Options label for protected files is used without the dialog's '(Recommended)' suffix (design wording). The full resolved strings are recorded in the design note.
Walk's open-failure outcome now carries the Hidden/System attributes and the View it read, where it used to carry false/false. The reason and HRESULT are unchanged.
ExplorerView is a sealed record class, not a struct, so the override can be published with Volatile.Write/Read as the design requires.
No release-notes or known-limits list exists in this repository, so Q-197's Windows 10 limit is recorded only in docs/design/SL-091-hidden-reveal-refuses.md.
not_built: R-001 and R-002 were not run: their steps open real Explorer windows and are person-run (Q-176 covered SL-089 only). R-001 step 5 is updated to the derived expectation but has not been executed through this build.

The Hidden=2 / ShowSuperHidden=0 sitting (0/13 re-measurement through the exe, the host ancestor harness on 26200, WindowsApps, System-only items), the (1,1)/(2,1) cells, the mid-session toggle, and the Windows 10 check all need a person to change Explorer's settings or use another machine. They are filed in the design note.
The architecture record edit for C-004 is proposed in `architecture`, not applied: no stage can write the record (Q-125).
follow_ups: WindowCases.ps1 Invoke-Sized returns the output of CheckActed, CheckSized, CheckDrives and CheckStatusShown along with its result, so S-001..S-008 never print those check lines. Failures are still counted. This was already the case before SL-091.

B-008 fails 'the outcome's title and detail run longer than a system drive's' (384 against 400 characters) when TEMP is C:\WINDOWS\TEMP, as in the engine's sessions: the root is 18 characters shorter than under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp, where it passes. The case should pad its root to a fixed length, as R-001 does.
Rule A could also name SHGetSettings, the older read-only reader of the same shell state, which attempt 1's rule had.
WindowMutants.ps1 still hard-codes the -Mutant All roster beside the ValidateSet. Q-115's startup check that the two agree is not built, so every new mutant has to be added twice.
docs/design/SL-088-reveal-lands-or-refuses.md still describes the old hidden note and the H+S gap as SL-088 shipped them. SL-091's note supersedes it, but nothing in that file points there.
